flow_anomaly.headline: BTC inflows snap 4-day streak — institutional rotation likely
reasoning: Four consecutive days of net inflows suddenly reversed by a $50M outflow.
Magnitude of the break is consistent with a single-fund de-risking move, not panic.
Streak length of 4 days falls in the upper quartile for 2026 to-date.
risks: Single-day reversal could be noise from quarter-end rebalancing.
ETH flows remain positive — divergence may resolve by ETH weakening, not BTC strengthening short.

magnitude.headline: BTC ETF inflows cross $500M threshold for the first time this quarter
reasoning: Single-day net inflow of $512M is 3.2 standard deviations above the 30-day mean.
Inflow concentrated in IBIT and FBTC, suggesting mainstream broker demand rather than basis-trade activity.
Comparable spikes in 2024 Q1 preceded multi-week BTC rallies.
risks: Spikes can mark local tops if they coincide with retail FOMO peaks.
Macro calendar shows CPI in 48h — outsized flow may be front-running known event.

acceleration.headline: Flow acceleration ambiguous — wait for confirmation
reasoning: 3-day rate of change is positive but within the historical noise band.
Underlying spot price action lags the flow signal — divergence reduces conviction.
risks: Acting on weak acceleration signals historically underperforms net of fees.
